notes: outlived is read as one rendering of he'eriku yamim ahare; the alternative splits the verb and its cognate object and leaves the preposition unrepresented.

Large-source-unit check: the three morphemes are contiguous and the ASV writes one English word for them, which carries the prolonging, the days and the following-after alike, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met and no morpheme owns a part of the word. Head on the verb, which carries the lexeme (rule 23).

In all the great work of Jehovah the single the goes to the present article on ha-gadol, the construct ma'aseh keeping only its own word (rule 47); in all the days of the elders the rectum is rendered arthrously, so nothing is fronted (rule 29).
